fields.label: Total CQI (grand total of all CQI inputs for this student)
fields.description: Sum of all CQI input values entered for the current student across all covered COs. Useful for whole-student threshold checks.

fields.label: X — alias for CQI input value
fields.description: Alias for [CQI]. The raw CQI mark entered by faculty for this student/CO.

fields.label: After CQI COx Total — CO total after CQI (dynamic alias)
fields.description: Dynamic alias for the current CO weighted total AFTER CQI is applied. Equivalent to AFTER_CQI when used in a per-CO context. COX is substituted with the actual CO number at runtime.

fields.label: CO Raw marks (current CO, from exams)
fields.description: Total raw marks obtained by the student for the current CO across all non-CQI exams.

fields.label: Before CQI (current CO total before adding CQI marks)
fields.description: The weighted CO total accumulated from all non-CQI exams for the current CO, BEFORE any CQI contribution is applied. This is the primary attainment check token.

fields.label: CQI input value (entered by faculty for this CO)
fields.description: The raw CQI mark entered by the faculty for the current student and CO (0–10 scale).

fields.label: After CQI (current CO total after adding CQI marks)
fields.description: The estimated CO total AFTER applying the CQI contribution. Equals BEFORE_CQI + CQI input value.

fields.label: CO Total Raw (alias for CO-RAW)
fields.description: Alias for [CO-RAW]. Provided for clarity in formulas.

fields.label: CO Total Weight % (alias for CO-WEIGHT)
fields.description: Alias for [CO-WEIGHT]. Provided for clarity in formulas.

fields.label: CO Weighted % (current CO, before CQI)
fields.description: Weighted percentage for the current CO: (CO-RAW / CO-MAX) × 100.

fields.label: Before CQI COx Total — CO total before CQI (dynamic alias)
fields.description: Dynamic alias for the current CO weighted total BEFORE CQI is applied. Equivalent to BEFORE_CQI when used in a per-CO context. COX is substituted with the actual CO number at runtime.

fields.label: COx Percent — weighted % for the current CO (dynamic alias)
fields.description: Dynamic alias that resolves to CO1_PERCENT, CO2_PERCENT, … at runtime based on the current CO being evaluated. Equals (CO-RAW / CO-MAX) × 100. Use this in conditions to check if the student has attained the threshold for THIS CO.

fields.label: CO Maximum marks (current CO)
fields.description: Maximum achievable marks for the current CO across all non-CQI exams.
